# BookDB Repository Agent Entry Point

All AI agents MUST read:

1. `agent-kit/constitution/AGENT_CONSTITUTION.md`
2. `agent-kit/constitution/AUTHORITY_MODEL.md`
3. the agent role file selected for the current task
4. the current TaskPacket and AuthorityLease when performing execution work

No agent may infer broad repository write authority from this file.

The Orchestrator is explicitly non-implementing.
